archetypes.name: dyn-route-handoff-parse
archetypes.rationale: Route handoff parser must skip lowercase ledger keys without weakening uppercase fail-closed checks.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect read_key in step-8-ci-fixer.sh and the new Git-backed harness cases. Confirm non-uppercase keys are ignored, duplicate uppercase keys and control characters in uppercase values still fail closed, and the lowercase-ledger fixture reaches unknown-ci-failure-scope rather than invalid-route-handoff. Check that validation order does not apply value checks to ignored keys. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
